title: Infant formula, Enfamil Nutramigen, powder, made with water

content.title: About
content.content: Enfamil Nutramigen is a hypoallergenic infant formula based on partially hydrolyzed protein, designed for babies with heightened sensitivity to cow’s milk. The powder is reconstituted with water to create a nutritious drink that provides essential proteins, fats, carbohydrates, vitamins, and minerals for growth and development.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Nutramigen is formulated to reduce the risk of allergic reactions in infants suspected of food allergy.
The formula contains partially hydrolyzed protein, which is easier to digest and less allergenic than intact cow’s milk protein.
Clinical studies have demonstrated its efficacy in managing atopic dermatitis and food‑related allergies.
Available in various package sizes, making it convenient for travel and long‑term storage.
The product is lactose‑free, suitable for infants with lactose intolerance.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Enriched with prebiotics and vitamins A, C, D, the formula helps strengthen the infant’s immune system.

items.title: Optimal growth and development
items.content: A balanced blend of protein, fat, and carbohydrates supplies energy and building blocks for tissue growth.

items.title: Reduced allergy risk
items.content: Hydrolyzed protein lowers the likelihood of food‑allergy development compared with standard milk‑based formulas.

items.title: Digestive comfort
items.content: Contains probiotic strains and easily digestible fats that promote healthy digestion and regular stools.

items.title: Essential micronutrients
items.content: Provides iron, zinc, calcium, and phosphorus in amounts aligned with the needs of infants in their first year.

items.title: Cow‑milk protein allergy
items.content: Despite being hypoallergenic, some infants may still react to the hydrolyzed protein.

items.title: Improper reconstitution
items.content: Too concentrated or too diluted a mixture can lead to dehydration or excess calorie intake.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: The formula contains added carbohydrates; oral hygiene is important to prevent tooth decay.

items.title: Storage after opening
items.content: If the container is exposed to moisture, the powder can clump and lose its nutritional quality.

content.title: How to Prepare
content.content: Measure the recommended amount of powder, add clean boiled water, and mix thoroughly until smooth. Allow the mixture to cool to body temperature before feeding.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the unopened container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, use within 30 days and discard if clumps, off‑odor, or discoloration appear.
